//: Deploy-ISOLATED config for the apps/mercado-pago/functions (codebase `mercado-pago`) Cloud Functions — the MP notification processor + reprocess sweep (#531). Contains ONLY a functions block — deliberately NO firestore/storage/emulators keys — so a deploy with this config can never push the Flutter-owned rules (root `CLAUDE.md`, Critical rules). Separate per-channel codebase so each payment channel deploys and scales independently. The predeploy hook runs apps/mercado-pago/functions/scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs, which esbuild-bundles the function + writes a MINIMAL workspace-free package.json. The function needs FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID + admin creds in its env. Deploy: firebase deploy --only functions:mercado-pago --config firebase.mercado-pago.deploy.json --project <id>. See apps/mercado-pago/functions/DEPLOY.md.
